Common Cold.description: A viral infection of your nose and throat (upper respiratory tract).

Flu (Influenza).description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses.
workout: Complete bed rest until fever subsides

Hypertension.description: A condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

Type 2 Diabetes.description: A chronic condition that affects the way the body processes blood sugar (glucose).

Migraine.description: A neurological condition causing severe throbbing headache usually on one side of the head.
precautions: Rest in a quiet dark room

Allergic Rhinitis.description: An allergic response causing itchy, watery eyes, sneezing and other similar symptoms.
precautions: Keep windows closed during high pollen count
workout: Indoor exercise during high pollen seasons

Asthma.description: A condition in which your airways narrow and swell and may produce extra mucus.
precautions: Avoid asthma triggers like smoke & dust

Gastritis.description: An inflammation of the protective lining of the stomach.

Urinary Tract Infection.description: An infection in any part of your urinary system — kidneys, bladder, or urethra.
precautions: Urinate when needed, don't hold it

Anxiety Disorder.description: A mental health disorder characterized by feelings of worry, anxiety, or fear.

Depression.description: A mood disorder that causes a persistent feeling of sadness and loss of interest.

Arthritis.description: Inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness that can worsen with age.

Pneumonia.description: An infection that inflames air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.

Insomnia.description: Persistent problems falling and staying asleep.

Hypothyroidism.description: A condition in which the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough crucial hormones.
precautions: Take thyroid medication on empty stomach

Zanamivir.dosage: 10 mg (2 inhalations) twice daily for 5 days

Salbutamol (Albuterol).dosage: 100-200 mcg inhaled every 4-6 hours as needed

Antacids.dosage: 10-20 mL after meals and at bedtime

Clonazepam.dosage: 0.5-1 mg at bedtime or twice daily

Azithromycin.dosage: 500 mg on day 1, then 250 mg daily for 4 days

Amoxicillin.dosage: 250-500 mg three times daily for 5-10 days (or 875 mg twice daily)

Levothyroxine.dosage: 25-100 mcg once daily in the morning on an empty stomach (30-60 mins before breakfast)
